title: Mars Global Surveyor images of possible fossilized life

tellings.quote: There are a number of these images from Mars Global Surveyor showing what look like they could well be maybe the skeletal structure of uh fossilized large forms of life on Mars.

plain: Some photos taken by Mars Global Surveyor, a NASA spacecraft that mapped Mars from 1997 to 2006, show what may be the skeletons of large fossilized life forms. This comes from a researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani, who tells Michels that "a number of these images" look like they "could well be" such remains, though he names no source. If he is right, Mars once had large animals.
